mission_prompt: Ingest uploaded government cloud migration RFP, extract mandatory technical compliance criteria, model multi-tier labor pricing, and generate a winning executive proposal with compliance traceability matrix.

units.task_name: Ingest and Parse the Uploaded RFP Document
units.description: Load the uploaded government cloud migration RFP (likely PDF or Word), convert it to plain text, and store the raw content in a structured format for downstream analysis.
units.input_contract: Requires verified outputs from upstream dependency nodes: [None - Initial Branch Node]
units.output_contract: Plain‑text representation of the entire RFP document stored as a variable or file.

units.description: Parse the plain‑text RFP to identify all mandatory technical compliance items (e.g., security controls, data residency, audit requirements). Output a structured list or table of these criteria with identifiers and brief descriptions.
units.input_contract: Requires verified outputs from upstream dependency nodes: [t1]
units.output_contract: Structured dataset (CSV/JSON) containing each compliance requirement, its unique ID, category, and description.

units.description: Using the extracted compliance criteria, design a multi‑tier labor pricing model (e.g., Tier 1: core migration, Tier 2: security hardening, Tier 3: ongoing support). Assign realistic hourly rates and estimate effort per tier based on typical industry benchmarks. Produce a cost table with total projected spend.
units.input_contract: Requires verified outputs from upstream dependency nodes: [t2]
units.output_contract: Pricing model spreadsheet or JSON containing tiers, roles, estimated hours, hourly rates, and subtotal/total costs.

units.task_name: Generate Executive Proposal with Compliance Traceability Matrix
units.description: Compose a polished executive proposal that: (1) summarizes the solution approach, (2) presents the multi‑tier pricing model, and (3) includes a traceability matrix linking each compliance requirement to the specific tier/solution component. Format the output as a structured document (e.g., Markdown or Word outline).
units.input_contract: Requires verified outputs from upstream dependency nodes: [t3]
units.output_contract: Complete proposal document with sections, pricing table, and traceability matrix.

dag.goal: Create a comprehensive executive proposal for a government cloud migration RFP that includes: (1) extraction of all mandatory technical compliance criteria from the uploaded document, (2) modeling of multi‑tier labor pricing based on those criteria, and (3) generation of a winning proposal with a traceability matrix linking each compliance requirement to the proposed solution.
dag.reasoning: The request requires processing an uploaded RFP, extracting structured requirements, performing quantitative modeling for labor costs, and synthesizing a final deliverable. This naturally decomposes into four sequential phases: ingestion & parsing, requirement extraction, pricing model construction, and proposal generation with traceability.
